protocol.cutter: inherit each source historical center/frame/radii; no search or adjustment
protocol.coordinate_rule: old cutter in original mesh space; require explicit original STL SPACE=RAS/LPS; map to canonical LPS
protocol.C: all raw nonzero binary foreground; no largest-component removal
protocol.R: closed ellipsoid evaluated at native voxel centers
protocol.output: full packed C/D/G, native affine, cutter provenance, exact interface audit; no sampled clouds
protocol.margin_basis: G bbox to image voxel-face planes, not entire cutter AABB
protocol.cutwall: six-neighbor D/G shared voxel faces; physical area/normals from affine
protocol.eligibility_reason: raw binary semantics/foreground anatomy not independently reviewed; geometric validity is a separate label
protocol.source_specific_rejections: record invalid source once, continue other frozen independent sources; no replacement
protocol.unexpected_execution_failure: stop batch without repair or retry
